display_name: Select the cheapest (model, effort) that clears a capability score
description: Given required_score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index scale, returns the cheapest accepted and fresh catalog cell that clears the score plus margin. dispatch_kind is provenance only; capability floors named by scope_tags are the only policy pair restriction. A cell is excluded only when its quota is known exhausted, which permits a cheaper cross-vendor fallback; an unknown quota never excludes a cell. The answer is an exact cost argmin with a selection_receipt that spawn_session replays before dispatch. Pass runtime (claude_code or codex) when the coordinator has already chosen the runtime: the catalog is filtered to that runtime before domination, so a cheaper cell of the other runtime cannot displace it, and the selection_receipt records it as runtime_constraint. Refuses rather than guesses: catalog_empty, catalog_stale, no_cell_clears_threshold, parameter_invalid, and quota_state_unknown when the shipped usage profile cannot be loaded. A flat-rate pool (the Claude subscription) is unknown with no reading and excludes nothing, so Claude cells are selectable with none recorded; an optional record_allowance_pool_reading showing the pool exhausted excludes its cells until the reading expires, and the answer's expired_allowance_readings and any refusal name expired ones. Under a runtime constraint covered by a current flat-rate plan that declares dispatch_weights, the default objective is allowance_weighted: relative cost times the plan's declared weight for the model (an operator preference, not a token or allowance conversion), reported in cost_basis; a covering plan with no weights keeps the metered-dollar ranking and adds a warnings line. Codex-constrained and unconstrained selections are not weighted.
embedding_description: Choosing which AI model and reasoning-effort setting to assign a piece of work so that it is capable enough for the job at the lowest cost, with the reasoning shown and a refusal when the price and score data are too old.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: selected (runtime, model, effort, capability_score, cost_per_task_usd, relative_cost_multiplier, measured_at, acceptance), billing_objective, required_score, effective_required_score, frontier, dominated, ladder, excluded counts, catalog_run_id, policy_version, unscored_cells, selection_receipt, expired_allowance_readings, and when present cost_basis and warnings.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Name the selected model and effort with its score and cost, then the next cheapest frontier alternative. If the ladder shows a near-zero points_per_cost_unit step, say that raising effort on this model buys little. Do not restate every excluded count unless asked.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass selected.runtime, selected.model, selected.effort, required_score as difficulty_score, and selection_receipt unchanged to spawn_session or dispatch_managed_work. A no_cell_clears_threshold refusal means the ask exceeds available capability; do not pick by hand. To spawn on a specific runtime, pass runtime to this verb and use the resulting receipt; a receipt issued without it is only valid for the runtime it selected unconstrained.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One catalog read plus an in-memory selection; the dispatch policy JSON is loaded when dispatch_kind is given. No writes, no network.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_stale: no cell is both accepted and inside its staleness window, so nothing may be served. catalog_empty: the catalog was never seeded. no_cell_clears_threshold: cells are fresh but none clears required_score + score_margin under the policy filter. parameter_invalid: required_score missing, an unknown billing_objective, allowance_weighted without a runtime covered by a plan that declares dispatch_weights, a negative margin or tolerance, a non-positive max_staleness_hours, or a runtime that is not claude_code or codex. dispatch_policy_violation / dispatch_policy_invalid / dispatch_policy_unavailable: the dispatch_kind or the policy file is bad. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. quota_state_unknown: with no runtime constraint, the shipped usage profile cannot be loaded. usage_economics_invalid: with a runtime constraint the profile is loaded before quota is read, so an unloadable or malformed profile (a malformed dispatch_weights table included) refuses here instead of quota_state_unknown; it is also the refusal when two current flat-rate plans cover the runtime, because their dispatch weights would be ambiguous.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For catalog_stale, run or wait for a refresh run that accepts cells, and check read_model_capability_catalog with include_unaccepted=true to see what is pending. For no_cell_clears_threshold, read the frontier of a lower ask to see how far the catalog reaches. Never loosen max_staleness_hours to get an answer; the verb will not allow it.
